description.notes: GOLD SAVINGS APY INVESTIGATION - SYSTEM SELECTED WRONG CHECKING ACCOUNT AND CREDIT CARD FOR APY BOOSTS. Customer has a Gold Account (savings) with $96,000 balance, TWO checking accounts (Green Account with $8,500 and Purple Account with $2,100), and THREE credit cards (Platinum Rewards, Gold Rewards, EcoCard). The customer notices their interest payment is significantly lower than expected. IMPORTANT: Both checking account APY boosts and credit card APY bonuses do NOT stack - only the highest of each applies. The system error is that the system selected the WRONG accounts: using Purple Account checking (+0.1% instead of Green Account's +0.75%) and Gold Rewards Card (+0.025% instead of EcoCard's +0.6%). The actual correct APY is 6.85% (base 5.5% + Green checking boost 0.75% + EcoCard 0.6%), but only 5.625% was applied (base 5.5% + Purple 0.1% + Gold Rewards 0.025%). The agent must: (1) look up documentation to find all accounts and their APY boost values, (2) discover the customer has multiple checking accounts and credit cards, (3) look up both stacking policies (checking accounts and credit cards), (4) identify that the highest boosts should apply (Green Account and EcoCard), (5) calculate the real discrepancy ($98.00), (6) apply a credit for $98.00, and (7) submit an interest discrepancy report. This tests the agent's ability to investigate complex multi-account scenarios and identify which accounts should be providing APY benefits.

9. **If agent mentions submitting a report to prevent future issues:** "Yes, please do that. I need to make sure the system uses the right accounts going forward."

10. **If agent confirms everything is done (credit applied and report submitted):** "Thank you for catching this. I had no idea the system could pick the wrong accounts for my boosts!" ###STOP###
